excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content:
Update reg porting the PQ registration contracts to sys-asm. I [opened the PR](https://github.com/ethereum/sys-asm/pull/60):
- Both contracts (validators and builders) are potuz's geas from the EIP, plus a call to a Solidity verifier for the proof of possession, as lightclient suggested.
- The queue isn't the same as the other queues in sys-asm. It has the fee changes that potuz did to allow requests before the fork, which were already in the EIP's geas and I didn't touch.
- The leanXMSS verifier contract lives in https://github.com/ethereum/leanxmss-evm-verifier, which is the old `pq-staking-contracts` repo. (I removed the Solidity queue from it ([#16](https://github.com/ethereum/leanxmss-evm-verifier/pull/16)) and renamed it ([#17](https://github.com/ethereum/leanxmss-evm-verifier/pull/17)), since it doesn't have staking contracts anymore).

The EIP still describes the Solidity contracts, so it needs an update after all this is eventually merged. cc <@543900561460822016>  <@592004585506340885> <@755590043632140352> reviews are welcome.
